question: Where should the deity be visualized in this meditative setting?
premises: The setting is at the base of a wish-fulfilling tree.
The deity is on a jewel lion-throne.
Both the place and throne are delightful and auspicious.
inference: The deity should be visualized on an auspicious jewel throne at the base of a delightful wish-fulfilling tree.
plain_english: Visualize him at the base of a delightful wish-fulfilling tree, upon an auspicious jewel lion-throne.
